takes.h: The Return of the Living Dead sequel casts Johnny Knoxville and Doug Jones
takes.p: Dread Central, citing Deadline, reports Johnny Knoxville, Doug Jones, Sean Gunn, Ruby Snowber and Blake Richardson are set to star in filmmaker Steve Wolsh's direct sequel to Dan O'Bannon's 1985 film, set in 1984. Tony Gardner is overseeing the zombie designs, and shooting is planned for the spring.
